start: A member who updated from a version with the Progress tab; an old notification or What's new button points to /progress

user_sees: The Profile tab with the chart and 'Your progress' rows
The screen the member came from, or the app closes as from any tab
must_not: A loop back to the redirect

start: A mistyped or retired forgeai:// link (for example from an old message)

user_sees: The Workout tab with one calm line 'That link didn't work.' above Up next

must_not: The line coming back on the next visit to the tab

start: An old home-screen widget or shortcut that opens /bodyweight, /measurements?kind=waist or /measurements/log

steps.action: Tap the old Body weight shortcut
user_sees: The Body page on Body weight
must_not: A second, older Body weight page

steps.action: Tap the old Measurements link with kind waist
must_not: The Body page on a different measure
A saved entry made by opening the link
Any of them landing on a blank or error screen

start: App closed; the member last opened it from a 'Start Push Day A' link, now taps the 'Log body weight' app-icon shortcut

user_sees: The body weight log, from this launch's link
must_not: 'Start Push Day A?' from the previous link

steps.action: Close the app and open it from the plain icon
must_not: The body weight page opening again from the old link

start: A broken old link /measurements?kind=../../x or kind with capitals and spaces

user_sees: The Body page with its default measure
must_not: The odd text shown as a measure name

start: A bad link was tapped and the Workout tab showed 'That link didn't work.'

steps.action: Switch to the Gym tab and back to the Workout tab
user_sees: The line is gone, or still there once until tapped, never a second copy
must_not: A What's new card and the link line drawn together

user_sees: Its page, and no 'That link didn't work.' line
must_not: The old bad-link line shown for a good link
